args.lesson: Before building any Apify Actor, run a narrow job-specific Store query (for example search=csv validator), not a broad keyword. Broad keywords surface adjacent high-usage Actors and hide the fact that direct competitors have about 0 users. The CSV preflight idea passed unit economics but failed demand: 12 validators had at most 1 user in 30 days. Economics checks are only worth doing after demand is proven. Keep csv-preflight parked, with no further build turns; if the founder supplies Apify access, list it at zero extra cost under the existing kill threshold.
